sections.heading: Find your contacts
body: Open Profile, then the Sharing tile and Contacts. Add a contact using the email address of an existing Flovers account or their Flovers ID.
Your Flovers ID appears on the Contacts screen with a copy button. It stays the same when you change your email address.

sections.heading: Invite by email
body: Invite someone who does not have a Flovers account yet. We will email them instructions in the selected language. Invitations expire after 30 days.
Install Flovers and create an account using this email address. Verify your email, then open Profile / Sharing / Contacts within 30 days to see the invitation.
You can accept or decline the contact request. No plants are shared automatically.
This email is already registered. Use Add contact instead.

sections.heading: Invitations and contact details
body: Incoming and outgoing invitations appear above your accepted contacts. Accept or decline an incoming invitation, or cancel an invitation you sent. The invitation must be accepted before plants can be shared.
Use the three-dot menu to edit a contact name or remove a contact. The name you choose is visible only to you. Contact details show plants shared in both directions and let you start sharing.

sections.heading: Remove a contact
body: Removing a contact ends plant access in both directions. Adding the person again does not restore the previous sharing permissions.
